learner_before: The hash-bound learner state and known closure establish zero bankable language, grammar, instruction convention, response convention, world grounding, or lived experience.
L000 is compiled-ready but not conducted; none of its language, objects, interactions, or conventions may be treated as learned.
language_after: Recognize and produce exactly these eight bare labels for their visually grounded ordinary table-object kinds: cup, plate, spoon, bowl, fork, knife, glass, napkin.
Discriminate each label across reviewed photographs and drawings without requiring or crediting sentence forms, articles, plural marking, yes/no words, question frames, or learner-facing grammar.
world_knowledge_after: Cup, plate, spoon, bowl, fork, knife, glass, and napkin are eight distinct ordinary table-object kinds; each kind remains the same across varied reviewed photographs and drawings despite changes in depiction style and visible shape.
dual_use_thesis: Through one coherent visual matching event, Ninereeds binds eight bare labels to eight distinct ordinary table-object kinds and learns that depiction style and shape variation do not change which kind each label names.

sets.purpose: Curriculum-named core lexical set, grounded as four distinct ordinary table-object kinds.
Coherent completion set, grounded with the same visual contrast and bare-label response boundary.

material_count.rationale: Accepted material-scope decision authorizes exactly two tested sets of four. Eight labels make the full lexical grounding lesson substantial while preserving the single lexical Point and excluding later sentence forms.

forbidden_assumptions: Do not treat any compiled but unconducted prerequisite as learned, and do not import L000 language, entities, instruction routines, or world knowledge.
Do not add scored vocabulary, grammar, articles, plural marking, yes/no words, question frames, corrective clauses, or sentence production beyond the eight bare labels.
All learner-facing scored responses remain bare labels or nonverbal selections; machine controls must not smuggle in later sentence forms.
Do not count copying a displayed string, visual-style recognition, container or utensil shape shortcuts, scaffolded recovery, or machine-control actions as independent label production.
Do not convert interface behavior, sorting mechanics, or story staging into scored world knowledge beyond the eight ordinary object-kind distinctions.
identity_and_chronology_hazards: Use unnamed instructional exemplars and ordinary objects only; introduce no named, persistent, recurring, or owned participant.
Depictions create no canonical event, relationship, location state, biography, or chronology beyond each locally frozen instructional scene.

The picture book must be one noncanonical instructional micro-event with persistent objects: separated table objects are matched to their distinct positions, and the completed arrangement is the stopping state.
Do not imply Ninereeds has human sensory experience; inaccessible embodied concepts are represented only through reviewed visuals, language, and logged controls.
grounding_event_seed: The lesson's reviewed photographs and drawings first show the eight ordinary table objects in varied depictions. Its bounded picture-book micro-event then begins with one cup, plate, spoon, bowl, fork, knife, glass, and napkin separated from eight distinct matching positions; across connected pages the same objects are moved into their matching positions; it resolves when all eight are visibly distinguished in one completed arrangement. The event is noncanonical, has no named or recurring person, and scores only object-kind meaning and the eight bare labels, with all actions represented by frozen nonverbal controls.
